plan.question: Does learning the even component separately improve residual generalization without preventing learning an even target?
plan.motivation: In the existing LR0.01 shallow checkpoints, even-component energy accounts for0.0224 to0.0249 relative MSE although the original tanh teacher is odd. The odd-part error alone remains0.0561 to0.0642, above the unchanged0.05 threshold. This is a diagnosis, not a solved case.
plan.architecture_change: Replace shifted SwiGLU (1+SiLU(g))*v by (1+0.5*g*tanh(0.5*g)+0.5*b*g)*v. Learn one scalar b per branch, initialized to0. At b=1 this is the parent in real arithmetic, so even functions are still representable. Keep the output projection, input/output RMS, zero-initialized post-RMS residual gate and depth scaling. Add exactly D parameters; preserve every original matrix entry and RNG draw.
plan.mixed_teacher: For the same frozen sphere inputs x and orthogonal R, use residual tanh(xR)+0.5*((xR)^2-1), elementwise. This new control explicitly needs an even component. Original teacher arrays remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No additional training examples or data augmentation.
plan.unchanged_protocol: Use all original depths4/16, strengths0.25/1 and seeds0/1/2, hidden width43, train512/heldout512, data seed1, batch64, AdamW betas0.9/0.98 epsilon1e-8 decay0.01, warmup16, budget512, observation32 and target relativeMSE<=0.05. Apply the same optimizer treatment to the extra scalars. Reuse the12 original-teacher LR0.01 shifted controls; run both arms on the mixed teacher and the new arm on the original teacher. Preserve every outcome and checkpoint.
plan.selection: Report each teacher separately and all24 cells per activation arm. Rank pooled threshold coverage, then geometric-mean first-crossing updates only with all24 passes; otherwise worst final relative MSE over all24, median as tie-break. No filtered successful-cell aggregate. Require all48 comparison rows before selecting. Improvement on the original odd teacher alone is not a universal-model win.
plan.scope: Adaptive synthetic follow-up informed by the already observed residual stress results. The mixed teacher is an explicit countercheck of the symmetry bias, not a broad unseen-task evaluation. No original data, threshold, budget, early99 selection or main model changes; no long-suite outcomes used. The original tiny-shifted controls and all previous failed fixes remain retained.

parent_settings.data: Independent Gaussian vectors normalized to RMS one. A fixed random orthogonal R defines targets y=x+a*tanh(xR), at strengths a=0.25 and 1.0. All seeds, variants and depths share both fixed splits and R. No learned readout hides the residual task.
parent_settings.models: Every branch uses the same initialized bias-free SwiGLU F(RMS(h)). pre_unit adds the raw branch; peri_unit adds RMS(F); peri_sqrt adds RMS(F)/sqrt(D); peri_depth adds RMS(F)/D. peri_post_gate multiplies the peri_sqrt branch by 2*sigmoid(s), s=0. peri_pre_gate instead puts that gain inside output RMS. peri_rezero uses s/sqrt(D), s=0, after output RMS. These are isolated adaptations, not reproductions of entire ReZero or mHC training recipes. Gates add D scalar parameters; all original matrices and batch orders match.
parent_settings.measurement: Run every cell for all 512 updates unless a numerical failure occurs; observe full train/held-out relative MSE at step zero and every 32 updates. Relative MSE divides by mean squared teacher residual y-x on the same split. Record first <=0.05 crossing, final losses, hidden norms, gradient norms and final input-Jacobian singular values. Preserve all histories, checkpoints, optimizer state and fingerprints.
parent_settings.ranking: Rank by number of the 12 cells per variant reaching threshold. If all 12 pass, compare geometric-mean first-crossing updates. Otherwise compare worst final relative MSE across all 12 (nonfinite is worst); use median final error only as a tie-break. Report all seed/depth/strength regressions. Best means best among these declared small residual tests; it does not authorize replacing the main transformer. No retuning after outcomes.
